lines.text: In twenty twenty-four, the FBI got almost two hundred thousand phishing complaints,
so here's how to spot a fake email in four quick checks.
One, look at the real sender address, not just the name,
because anyone can call themselves your bank.
Two, hover over the link before you click it,
and make sure it goes where it says it does.
Three, watch out for pressure, like act now or lose your account.
That panic is exactly what they want.
And four, never send a password or a login code by email.
Anyone who asks for one is running a scam.
Send this to the friend who clicks every link.
